hero.title: Black Phone 2
hero.about: Scott Derrickson returns to direct this sequel to 2021's The Black Phone. Set several years after the original — Finney (Mason Thames) and his sister Gwen (Madeleine McGraw) are still living with the trauma of their kidnapping when The Grabber (Ethan Hawke) seemingly returns from the dead. The Grabber's reach now extends through dreams, drawing Finney back into one more fight. Pulls from a Joe Hill short story. R-rated.
hero.why: Tier 4 best-taste-match hero. Horror/Suspense is your top-4 genre and there's no Loved-list continuation this week. 80% critic / 82% audience, $132M worldwide — original cast + director back. Drops Saturday — exactly the bedtime horror slot. The original was a contained, plot-twist-driven story; sequel is reportedly ambitious and effective.
